purpose: Every effectful call site in greg/ and foundry/systems/ (a child process, an outbound connection or an inbound listener, and every caller of a declared wrapper), keyed by module, enclosing qualname and callee with an occurrence count, and what governs it. Read by tests/unit/test_effect_call_allowlist.py; a site missing here, an entry with no site, or a wrong count fails it. Listing a site authorizes nothing: this is a review-time inventory, not a grant.
rule: allowed: the site is reached only through a registered capability's adapter (its manifest, signed mission scope and Gate), the confinement those adapters run behind (run_isolated, the worker envelope, the #26 relay and door), the supervised worker path, a founder-signed selection or command, or a command a person runs by hand (greg CLI, installer, python -m harness, CI audit). known_unmediated: the body reaches the site on its own schedule (body-loop:) with none of those behind it; each is a finding, kept so it cannot grow silently, not an approval. wrappers: in-tree functions that pass an effect on with no check of their own; every call or reference to one is a site, keyed by the wrapper's dotted name, unless it keeps the wrapper's exempt_when keywords at their literal.
